name: Málkov (Czechia)
description: Divided vertically, the hoist half white over green and the fly half green, blue and white, with a large white semicircle at the hoist half.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 6 June 2017 (decision No. 68) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
